svg.title: Dose 01 medallion — meander v3.1 with finish final-A, relative bands (finish5), slot820
svg.desc: Geometry: meander v3.1 channel outline (meander3.js: rc 8, rf 7, phase 0). Finish: body #B29F7B over the whole footprint with the measured sector sweeps (A axis 83.094°, B axis 307.5°) and zone-gated foil grain (fractalNoise 0.09/print px seed 17; zones seed 23; flecks top ≈2 % @0); then RELATIVE bands clipped to the footprint: rim (0–0.9 px) black @0.65, transition (0.9–2.2 px) black @0.11, ridge (2.2–4.8 px) black @0, centre (inside 4.8 px) black @0.16; highlight cap #F2E4B8. Ink footprint = geometry. Pure vector, deterministic. Fresnel edge (finish6): bands rt opacity x(1-0*max(cos2(theta-83.094),0)); catch-light 0-0.5 px #FFF9E3 @0.3*max(cos2,0). Organic bands (finish7): band group displaced by fractalNoise (0.02/print px, 2 oct, seed 7) scale 2.5 px and blurred σ 0.8 px before the footprint clip; rim as a 0.8 px stroke of the outline (half outside, clipped).
